metrics.profile_summary: Performance marketing specialist with 4 years of experience specializing in Facebook and TikTok ads. Proven track record of managing $10M+ in spend and significantly improving ROAS and CPA for diverse clients.

experience.description: Managed international ad campaigns on Facebook and TikTok, led content creation teams, and collaborated with web developers.
Handled media buying, performance tracking, and budget management while developing strategic media plans for clients.
Optimized campaigns resulting in a 40% revenue increase, 60% CPA decrease, and 70% ROAS increase.
Executed and managed advertising campaigns for various brands and independent clients.

strengths: Exceptional track record in paid social acquisition
weaknesses: Lack of explicit experience in organic content scheduling and community management
Degree is in Arts rather than a specialized Marketing/Communications field
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled performance marketer who exceeds the experience requirements. While their profile leans heavily toward paid ads rather than organic content management, their ability to drive revenue and lead content teams makes them a strong fit.
